versions.subject: Renamed rule files, new rules
versions.detection:
dllload1:
    - EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
    - EventID: 7
    - Image: 'C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe'
    - ImageLoaded: '*\vaultcli.dll'
dllload2:
    - EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
    - EventID: 7
    - Image: 'C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe'
    - ImageLoaded: '*\wlanapi.dll'        
exclusion:
    - EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
    - EventID: 7
    - Image: 'C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe'
    - ImageLoaded:
        - 'ntdsapi.dll'
        - 'netapi32.dll'
        - 'imm32.dll'
        - 'samlib.dll'
        - 'combase.dll'
        - 'srvcli.dll'
        - 'shcore.dll'
        - 'ntasn1.dll'
        - 'cryptdll.dll'
        - 'logoncli.dll'
timeframe: last 30s
condition: ( dllload1 and dllload2 ) and not exclusion
versions.spl: EventLog="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" OR EventID=7 OR Image="C:\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32.exe" OR ImageLoaded="*\\vaultcli.dll" EventLog="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" OR EventID=7 OR Image="C:\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32.exe" OR ImageLoaded="*\\wlanapi.dll" NOT (EventLog="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" OR EventID=7 OR Image="C:\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32.exe" OR ImageLoaded IN ("ntdsapi.dll", "netapi32.dll", "imm32.dll", "samlib.dll", "combase.dll", "srvcli.dll", "shcore.dll", "ntasn1.dll", "cryptdll.dll", "logoncli.dll"))
